if self.bead_released.load(Ordering::SeqCst) == 1 {\n                return Err(anyhow::anyhow!(\"test complete - bead was released\"));\n            }\n            let count = bead.as_ref().unwrap().id) {\n                    Ok(vec![bead.clone().unwrap()])\n                } else {\n                    Ok(vec![])\n                }\n            } else {\n        all.push(b.clone());\n                }\n            }\n            Ok(all)\n        }\n\n        async fn show(&self, id: &BeadId) -> Result<Bead> {\n            let claimed = self.bead.lock().unwrap();\n            match bead.as_ref() {\n                Some(b) if b.id == *id => Ok(b.clone()),\n                _ => anyhow::bail!(\"bead not found: {id}\"),\n            }\n        }\n\n        async fn claim(&self, id: &BeadId, actor: &str) -> Result<ClaimResult> {\n            let bead = self.bead.lock().unwrap();\n            let mut claimed =          }\n                _ => Ok(ClaimResult::NotClaimable {\n                    reason: \"no bead\".to_string(),\n                }),\n            }\n        }\n\n        async fn   .and_then(|b| b.assignee.clone())\n            .unwrap_or_else(|| \"unknown\".to_string())\n    }\n\n    /// Promote learning entries with reinforcement_count >= 3 to skill files.\n    ///\n    /// Creates `.beads/skills/<slug>.md` for each promoted entry.\n    /// Returns the number of skills created this run.\n    fn promote_to_skills(&self, entries: &[LearningEntry]) -> Result<usize> {\n        let skills_dir = self.workspace.join(\".beads\").join(\"skills\");\n        let mut promoted = 0usize;\n\n        // Build set of already-promoted bead IDs to avoid re-promoting.\n        let already_promoted = self.read_promoted_ids(&skills_dir);\n\n        for entry in entries {\n            if promoted >= self.config.max_skills_per_run {\n                break;\n            }\n            if entry.reinforcement_count < 3 {\n                continue;\n            }\n            if already_promoted.contains(&entry.bead_id) {\n                continue;\n            }\n\n            match self.write_skill_file(&skills_dir, entry) {\n                Ok(()) => promoted += 1,\n                Err(e) => {\n                    tracing::warn!(bead_id = %entry.bead_id, error = %e, \"reflect: failed to write skill file\");\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        Ok(promoted)\n    }\n\n    /// Read the set of bead IDs that have already been promoted to skills.\n    fn read_promoted_ids(&self, _skills_dir: &Path) -> std::collections::HashSet<String> {\n        match SkillLibrary::load(&self.workspace) {\n            Ok(lib) => lib.promoted_source_beads(),\n            Err(e) => {\n                tracing::warn!(error = %e, \"reflect: failed to load skill library for promoted IDs\");\n                std::collections::HashSet::new()\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// Scan known workspaces for learnings that match entries in the current workspace,\n    /// promoting matches (cross-workspace patterns) to the global learnings file.\n    ///\n    /// An entry is promoted when a similar observation appears in at least one other\n    /// known workspace. Returns the number of entries promoted this run.\n    fn promote_cross_workspace_patterns(&self, learnings: &LearningsFile) -> Result<usize> {\n        // Skip when not configured.\n        if self.global_learnings_path.as_os_str().is_empty() || self.known_workspaces.is_empty() {\n            return Ok(0);\n        }\n\n        let mut global = GlobalLearningsFile::load(&self.global_learnings_path)?;\n\n        // Load learnings files for all known workspaces, skipping failures.\n        let mut other_learnings: Vec<LearningsFile> = Vec::new();\n        for ws in &self.known_workspaces {\n            match LearningsFile::load(ws) {\n                Ok(lf) if !lf.entries().is_empty() => other_learnings.push(lf),\n                Ok(_) => {}\n                Err(e) => {\n                    tracing::warn!(\n                        workspace = %ws.display(),\n                        error = %e,\n                        \"reflect: failed to load learnings for cross-workspace scan\"\n                    );\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        if other_learnings.is_empty() {\n            return Ok(0);\n        }\n\n        let mut promoted = 0usize;\n\n        for entry in learnings.entries() {\n            // Check if any other workspace has a similar observation.\n            let appears_in_other = other_learnings\n                .iter()\n                .any(|other| !other.find_similar(&entry.observation).is_empty());\n\n            if !appears_in_other {\n                continue;\n            }\n\n            if global.promote(entry.clone(), self.max_global_learnings) {\n                promoted += 1;\n                let _ = self.telemetry.emit(EventKind::ReflectLearningPromoted {\n                    learning_id: entry.bead_id.clone(),\n                    target_path: self.global_learnings_path.display().to_string(),\n                    workspace_count: self.known_workspaces.len() + 1,\n                    is_decision: entry.decision_context.is_some(),\n                });\n                tracing::info!(\n                    bead_id = %entry.bead_id,\n                    observation = %entry.observation,\n                    \"reflect: promoted cross-workspace learning to global\"\n                );\n            }\n        }\n\n        if promoted > 0 {\n            global.write()?;\n        }\n\n        Ok(promoted)\n    }\n\n    /// Promote high-reinforcement learnings to CLAUDE.md files using the lowest common ancestor strategy.\n    ///\n    /// When a learning appears across multiple workspaces, it's written to the CLAUDE.md\n    /// at the lowest common ancestor directory covering all contributing workspaces.\n    /// Single-workspace learnings go to that workspace's CLAUDE.md.\n    fn promote_to_claude_md(&self, learnings: &LearningsFile) -> Result<usize> {\n        use crate::claude_md_placement::{ClaudeMdPlacer, PromotedLearning};\n\n        // Skip when not configured\n        if !self.config.claude_md_placement {\n            return Ok(0);\n        }\n\n        // Skip if no known workspaces configured\n        if self.known_workspaces.is_empty() {\n            return Ok(0);\n        }\n\n        // Build workspace list including current workspace\n        let mut all_workspaces = vec![self.workspace.clone()];\n        all_workspaces.extend(self.known_workspaces.clone());\n\n        // Create placer with all known workspaces\n        let placer = ClaudeMdPlacer::new(all_workspaces.clone());\n\n        // Load learnings from all workspaces to find cross-workspace patterns\n        let mut workspace_learnings: std::collections::HashMap<PathBuf, Vec<LearningEntry>> =\n            std::collections::HashMap::new();\n\n        for ws in &all_workspaces {\n            match LearningsFile::load(ws) {\n                Ok(lf) if !lf.entries().is_empty() => {\n                    workspace_learnings.insert(ws.clone(), lf.entries().to_vec());\n                }\n                Ok(_) => {}\n                Err(e) => {\n                    tracing::warn!(\n                        workspace = %ws.display(),\n                        error = %e,\n                        \"reflect: failed to load learnings for CLAUDE.md placement\"\n                    );\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        let mut placed = 0usize;\n\n        // For each entry in current workspace, check if it appears in other workspaces\n        for entry in learnings.entries() {\n            // Only promote high-confidence or high-reinforcement entries\n            if entry.confidence != crate::learning::Confidence::High\n                && entry.reinforcement_count < 2\n            {\n                continue;\n            }\n\n            let mut matching_workspaces = vec![self.workspace.clone()];\n\n            for (ws, entries) in &workspace_learnings {\n                if ws == &self.workspace {\n                    continue;\n                }\n\n                // Check if any entry in this workspace is similar\n                let has_similar = entries\n                    .iter()\n                    .any(|e| observations_similar(&e.observation, &entry.observation));\n\n                if has_similar {\n                    matching_workspaces.push(ws.clone());\n                }\n            }\n\n            // Place the learning at the appropriate CLAUDE.md\n            let promoted = PromotedLearning::new(entry.clone(), matching_workspaces);\n            match placer.place_learning(&promoted) {\n                Ok(true) => {\n                    placed += 1;\n                    // The placer doesn't return the exact path, so we use the workspace info\n                    let target_path = if promoted.source_workspaces.len() > 1 {\n                        // Cross-workspace learning - would be placed at LCA\n                        format!(\"LCA of {} workspaces\", promoted.source_workspaces.len())\n                    } else {\n                        self.workspace.join(\"CLAUDE.md\").display().to_string()\n                    };\n                    let _ = self.telemetry.emit(EventKind::ReflectClaudeMdWritten {\n                        path: target_path,\n                        entries_added: 1,\n                        entries_updated: 0,\n                    });\n                    tracing::info!(\n                        bead_id = %entry.bead_id,\n                        observation = %entry.observation,\n                        workspaces = ?promoted.source_workspaces,\n                        \"reflect: placed learning in CLAUDE.md\"\n                    );\n                }\n                Ok(false) => {\n                    // Duplicate, skipped\n                }\n                Err(e) => {\n                    tracing::warn!(\n                        bead_id = %entry.bead_id,\n                        error = %e,\n                        \"reflect: failed to place learning in CLAUDE.md\"\n                    );\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        Ok(placed)\n    }\n\n    /// Write a skill file for a promoted learning entry (YAML frontmatter format).\n    fn write_skill_file(&self, skills_dir: &Path, entry: &LearningEntry) -> Result<()> {\n        std::fs::create_dir_all(skills_dir)\n            .with_context(|| format!(\"failed to create skills dir: {}\", skills_dir.display()))?;\n\n        let slug = slugify(&entry.observation);\n        let filename = format!(\"{}-{}.md\", &slug[..slug.len().min(40)], &entry.bead_id);\n        let path = skills_dir.join(&filename);\n\n        let frontmatter = SkillFrontmatter {\n            task_types: vec![entry.bead_type.as_str().to_string()],\n            labels: vec![],\n            success_count: 0,\n            last_used: None,\n            source_beads: vec![entry.bead_id.clone()],\n        };\n\n        let body = format!(\n            \"## {}\\n\\n{}\\n\\n**Worker:** {}\\n**Source:** {}\\n\",\n            truncate(&entry.observation, 60),\n            entry.observation,\n            entry.worker,\n            entry.source,\n        );\n\n        let content = render_skill_file(&frontmatter, &body)\n            .with_context(|| format!(\"failed to render skill file: {filename}\"))?;\n\n        std::fs::write(&path, content)\n            .with_context(|| format!(\"failed to write skill file: {}\", path.display()))?;\n\n        tracing::info!(\n            bead_id = %entry.bead_id,\n            file = %filename,\n            reinforcement_count = entry.reinforcement_count,\n            \"reflect: promoted learning to skill file\"\n        );\n        Ok(())\n    }\n\n    /// Discover and parse recent transcripts, extract learning entries from them.\n    ///\n    /// Returns a tuple of (transcripts, learning_entries).\n    fn extract_from_transcripts(&self) -> Result<(Vec<ParsedTranscript>, Vec<LearningEntry>)> {\n        use std::collections::HashMap;\n\n        // Create transcript discovery with recency cutoff\n        let recency_cutoff =\n            Utc::now() - Duration::days(self.config.transcript_recency_days as i64);\n\n        // Build the full workspace list: primary + known (for multi-workspace support)\n        let transcripts = if self.known_workspaces.is_empty() {\n            TranscriptDiscovery::new(\n                &self.workspace,\n                None, // Use default ~/.claude\n                self.config.transcript_max_sessions,\n            )\n            .with_recency_cutoff(recency_cutoff)\n            .discover()\n            .with_context(|| \"failed to discover transcripts\")?\n        } else {\n            let mut all_workspaces = vec![self.workspace.as_path()];\n            all_workspaces.extend(self.known_workspaces.iter().map(|p| p.as_path()));\n\n            crate::transcript::discover_workspaces(\n                &all_workspaces,\n                None, // Use default ~/.claude\n                self.config.transcript_max_sessions,\n                self.config.transcript_max_sessions,\n                Some(recency_cutoff),\n            )\n            .with_context(|| \"failed to discover transcripts across workspaces\")?\n        };\n\n        if transcripts.is_empty() {\n            return Ok((Vec::new(), Vec::new()));\n        }\n\n        tracing::debug!(\n            count = transcripts.len(),\n            \"reflect: discovered recent transcripts\"\n        );\n\n        let _ = parse_errors: 0, // TODO: track parse errors if discovery reports them\n        });\n\n        let mut entries: Vec<LearningEntry> = Vec::new();\n        let mut tool_usage_counts: HashMap<String, tool_name) = action.tool_name {\n                    *tool_usage_counts.entry(tool_name.clone()).or_insert(0) += 1;\n                }\n            }\n\n            // Extract bead ID if present\n            let bead_id = transcript\n                .bead_id\n                .clone()\n                .unwrap_or_else(|| BeadId::from(format!(\"session-{}\", transcript.session_id)));\n            let bead_id_str = bead_id.to_string();\n\n            // Infer worker from context or use \"needle\"\n            let worker = \"needle\".to_string();\n\n            // Detect decisions in this transcript (ADR-style extraction)\n            let decisions = crate::transcript::detect_decisions(transcript);\n            for decision in decisions {\n                let observation = format!(\"Decision: {}\", truncate(&decision.decision, 200));\n\n                // Convert detected decision to learning entry with ADR context\n                let decision_context: crate::learning::DecisionContext = decision.clone().into();\n                let entry = LearningEntry::with_adr_context(\n                    bead_id_str.clone(),\n                    worker.clone(),\n                    BeadType::Feature, // Decisions often relate to feature choices\n                    observation,\n                    Confidence::Medium, // Decisions get medium confidence by default\n                    format!(\"transcript decision: {}\", transcript.session_id),\n                    decision_context,\n                );\n                entries.push(entry);\n\n                let _ = self.telemetry.emit(EventKind::ReflectDecisionExtracted {\n                    bead_id: bead_id.clone(),\n                    has_alternatives: !decision.alternatives.is_empty(),\n                    rationale_length: decision.rationale.len(),\n                });\n\n                tracing::debug!(\n                    decision = %decision.decision,\n                    confidence = decision.confidence,\n                    \"reflect: extracted decision from transcript\"\n                );\n            }\n\n            // Extract learning entries from action-outcome pairs\n            for action_outcome in &transcript.action_outcomes {\n                // Create a pattern from the action-outcome pair\n                let pattern =\n                    action_outcome.to_pattern(&transcript.session_id, transcript.modified_at);\n\n                // Convert frequent patterns to learning entries\n                if pattern.is_frequent(1) {\n                    // For now, all patterns are included (frequency threshold = 1)\n                    let observation =\n                        format!(\"Action-outcome: {} → {}\", pattern.action, pattern.outcome);\n\n                    let entry = LearningEntry::new(\n                        bead_id_str.clone(),\n                        worker.clone(),\n                        BeadType::Other,\n                        observation,\n                        Confidence::Medium,\n                        format!(\"transcript action-outcome: {}\", transcript.session_id),\n                    );\n                    entries.push(entry);\n                }\n\n                // Error outcomes get higher confidence learning entries\n                if action_outcome.is_error {\n                    let observation = format!(\n                        \"Error pattern: {} — {}\",\n                        action_outcome.action_description,\n                        truncate(&action_outcome.output, 150)\n                    );\n                    entries.push(LearningEntry::new(\n                        bead_id_str.clone(),\n                        worker.clone(),\n                        BeadType::BugFix,\n                        observation,\n                        Confidence::High,\n                        format!(\"transcript error: {}\", transcript.session_id),\n                    ));\n                }\n            }\n\n            // Extract learning entries from transcript actions (non-decision patterns)\n            for action in &transcript.actions {\n                let entry = match action.action_type {\n                    crate::transcript::ActionType::ToolUse => {\n                        // For tool use, create an entry about the tool usage pattern\n                        if let Some(ref tool_name) = action.tool_name {\n                            let observation = format!(\n                                \"Tool usage pattern: {} — {}\",\n                                tool_name, action.description\n                            );\n                            Some(LearningEntry::new(\n                                bead_id_str.clone(),\n                                worker.clone(),\n                                BeadType::Other,\n                                observation,\n                                Confidence::Medium,\n                                format!(\"transcript: {}\", transcript.session_id),\n                            ))\n                        } else {\n                            None\n                        }\n                    }\n                    crate::transcript::ActionType::Text => {\n                        // For text actions, look for patterns in the output\n                        if action.description.len() > 50 {\n                            // Only extract longer text responses as patterns\n                            let observation = format!(\n                                \"Assistant response pattern: {}\",\n                                truncate(&action.description, 200)\n                            );\n                            Some(LearningEntry::new(\n                                bead_id_str.clone(),\n                                worker.clone(),\n                                BeadType::Other,\n                                observation,\n                                Confidence::Low,\n                                format!(\"transcript: {}\", transcript.session_id),\n                            ))\n                        } else {\n                            None\n                        }\n                    }\n                    crate::transcript::ActionType::Thinking => {\n                        // Thinking blocks may contain useful reasoning patterns\n                        // Note: decisions are already extracted above, so skip decision-heavy blocks\n                        if action.description.len() > 30 {\n                            let observation = format!(\n                                \"Reasoning pattern: {}\",\n                                truncate(&action.description, 200)\n                            );\n                            Some(LearningEntry::new(\n                                bead_id_str.clone(),\n                                worker.clone(),\n                                BeadType::Other,\n                                observation,\n                                Confidence::Low,\n }\n                };\n\n                if let Some(entry) = entry {\n                    entries.push(entry);\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        // Log tool usage summary\n        if !tool_usage_counts.is_empty() {\n            let mut summary: Vec<_> = tool_usage_counts.iter().collect();\n            summary.sort_by(|a, b| b.1.cmp(a.1));\n            tracing::debug!(\n                top_tools = ?summary.iter().take(5).map(|(k, v)| (k, v)).collect::<Vec<_>>(),\n                \"reflect: transcript tool usage summary\"\n            );\n        }\n\n        Ok((transcripts, entries))\n    }\n\n    /// Detect drift across sessions and write a drift report.\n    ///\n    /// Returns the number of drift clusters found and the learning entries\n    /// extracted from drift patterns for feeding into the consolidation pipeline.\n    fn detect_drift(\n        &self,\n        transcripts: &[ParsedTranscript],\n    ) -> Result<(usize, Vec<LearningEntry>)> {\n        if !self.config.drift_enabled {\n            let _ = self.telemetry.emit(EventKind::DriftDetectionSkipped {\n                reason: \"drift detection disabled in config\".to_string(),\n            });\n            return Ok((0, Vec::new()));\n        }\n\n        if transcripts.len() < 2 {\n            let _ = self.telemetry.emit(EventKind::DriftDetectionSkipped {\n                reason: format!(\"need at least 2 sessions, got {}\", transcripts.len()),\n            });\n            return Ok((0, Vec::new()));\n        }\n\n        let _ = self.telemetry.emit(EventKind::DriftDetectionStarted {\n            sessions_analyzed: transcripts.len(),\n        });\n\n        // Create drift detector with configured similarity threshold\n        let detector = DriftDetector::new(self.config.drift_similarity_threshold);\n\n        // Detect drift\n        let report = detector.detect(transcripts)?;\n\n        // Categorize clusters\n        let evolved_count = report\n            .clusters\n            .iter()\n            .filter(|c| c.category == crate::drift::DriftCategory::Evolved)\n            .count();\n        let inconsistent_count = report\n            .clusters\n            .iter()\n            .filter(|c| c.category == crate::drift::DriftCategory::Inconsistent)\n            .count();\n\n        let _ = self.telemetry.emit(EventKind::DriftDetectionCompleted {\n            sessions_analyzed: report.sessions_analyzed,\n            clusters_found: report.clusters_detected,\n            evolved_count,\n            inconsistent_count,\n        });\n\n        // Emit ReflectDriftDetected for each cluster\n        for cluster in &report.clusters {\n            let sessions: Vec<String> = cluster\n                .sessions\n                .iter()\n                .map(|s| s.session_id.clone())\n                .collect();\n            let _ = self.telemetry.emit(EventKind::ReflectDriftDetected {\n                cluster_size: cluster.sessions.len(),\n                category: cluster.category.as_str().to_string(),\n                sessions,\n            });\n        }\n\n        // Extract learning entries from drift clusters\n        let drift_entries = report.to_learning_entries();\n\n        // Emit ReflectDriftPromoted for each drift cluster that produced learning entries\n        for cluster in &report.clusters {\n            let pattern = match cluster.category {\n                crate::drift::DriftCategory::Evolved => \"evolved-solution-pattern\".to_string(),\n                crate::drift::DriftCategory::Inconsistent => {\n                    \"inconsistent-approach-pattern\".to_string()\n                }\n                crate::drift::DriftCategory::Unknown => \"divergent-approach-pattern\".to_string(),\n            };\n            let _ = self.telemetry.emit(EventKind::ReflectDriftPromoted {\n                pattern: pattern.clone(),\n                category: cluster.category.as_str().to_string(),\n            });\n        }\n\n        // Write drift report if any clusters were found\n        if report.clusters_detected > 0 {\n            let drifts_dir = self.workspace.join(\".beads\").join(\"drifts\");\n            let timestamp = Utc::now().format(\"%Y%m%d-%H%M%S\");\n            let report_path = drifts_dir.join(format!(\"drift-{}.md\", timestamp));\n\n            report.write(&report_path)?;\n\n            let _ = self.telemetry.emit(EventKind::DriftReportWritten {\n                report_path: report_path.display().to_string(),\n                clusters: report.clusters_detected,\n            });\n\n            tracing::info!(\n                report_path = %report_path.display(),\n                clusters = report.clusters_detected,\n                evolved = evolved_count,\n                inconsistent = inconsistent_count,\n                drift_learnings = drift_entries.len(),\n                \"reflect: drift detection complete\"\n            );\n        }\n\n        Ok((report.clusters_detected, drift_entries))\n    }\n\n    /// Detect decision points in transcripts and write ADR records.\n    ///\n    /// Returns the number of decisions detected.\n    fn detect_decisions(&self, transcripts: &[ParsedTranscript]) -> Result<usize> {\n        if !self.config.adr_enabled {\n            let _ = self.telemetry.emit(EventKind::DecisionDetectionSkipped {\n                reason: \"ADR decision extraction disabled in config\".to_string(),\n            });\n            return Ok(0);\n        }\n\n        if transcripts.is_empty() {\n            let _ = self.telemetry.emit(EventKind::DecisionDetectionSkipped {\n                reason: \"no transcripts to analyze\".to_string(),\n            });\n            return Ok(0);\n        }\n\n        let _ = self.telemetry.emit(EventKind::DecisionDetectionStarted {\n            sessions_analyzed: transcripts.len(),\n        });\n\n        // Create decision detector\n        let detector = crate::decision::DecisionDetector::new();\n\n        // Detect decisions\n        let analysis = detector.analyze(transcripts)?;\n\n        let _ = self.telemetry.emit(EventKind::DecisionDetectionCompleted {\n            sessions_analyzed: analysis.transcripts_analyzed,\n            decisions_found: analysis.decisions.len(),\n        });\n\n        // Write ADR records if any decisions were found\n        if !analysis.decisions.is_empty() {\n            let decisions_dir = self.workspace.join(\".beads\").join(\"decisions\");\n            std::fs::create_dir_all(&decisions_dir).with_context(|| {\n                format!(\n                    \"failed to create decisions dir: {}\",\n                    decisions_dir.display()\n                )\n            })?;\n\n            for decision in &analysis.decisions {\n                let path = decisions_dir.join(format!(\"{}.md\", decision.id));\n                let content = decision.to_adr_markdown();\n                std::fs::write(&path, content)\n                    .with_context(|| format!(\"failed to write ADR: {}\", path.display()))?;\n\n                let bead_id = decision\n                    .bead_id\n                    .clone()\n                    .unwrap_or_else(|| BeadId::from(format!(\"session-{}\", decision.session_id)));\n                let _ = self.telemetry.emit(EventKind::ReflectAdrCreated {\n                    bead_id,\n                    path: path.display().to_string(),\n                });\n\n                tracing::debug!(\n                    decision_id = %decision.id,\n                    title = %decision.title,\n                    \"reflect: wrote ADR record\"\n                );\n            }\n\n            tracing::info!(\n                decisions_count = analysis.decisions.len(),\n                \"reflect: ADR decision detection complete\"\n            );\n        }\n\n        Ok(analysis.decisions.len())\n    }\n}\n\n#[async_trait::async_trait]\nimpl super::Strand for ReflectStrand {\n    fn name(&self) -> &str {\n        \"reflect\"\n    }\n\n    async fn evaluate(&self, _store: &dyn BeadStore, _exclusions: &HashSet<BeadId>) -> StrandResult {\n        if !self.config.enabled {\n            return StrandResult::NoWork;\n        }\n\n        // Check if the home bead store exists. If not, skip this strand.\n        // This distinguishes between \"no home store configured\" (expected for\n        // roam-only workers) and \"home store is broken\" (unexpected error).\n        if !_store.has_valid_store() {\n            tracing::info!(\n                \"Home workspace has no .beads/ directory — skipping Reflect strand \\\n                 (expected for roam-only workers)\"\n            );\n            return StrandResult::Skipped {\n                reason: \"no_home_store\".to_string(),\n            };\n        }\n\n        match self.consolidate(false).await {\n            Ok(_) => StrandResult::NoWork,\n            Err(e) => StrandResult::Error(StrandError::ConfigError(format!(\n                \"reflect consolidation failed: {e}\"\n            ))),\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n// Utilities\n// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n/// Create a URL-safe slug from a string.\nfn slugify(s: &str) -> String {\n    s.to_lowercase()\n        .chars()\n        .map(|c| if c.is_alphanumeric() { c } else { '-' })\n        .collect::<String>()\n        .split('-')\n        .filter(|s| !s.is_empty())\n        .collect::<Vec<_>>()\n        .join(\"-\")\n}\n\n/// Truncate a string to at most `max_chars` characters.\nfn truncate(s: &str, max_chars: usize) -> &str {\n    if s.len() <= max_chars {\n        s\n    } else {\n        let boundary = s\n            .char_indices()\n            .map(|(i, _)| i)\n            .take_while(|&i| i <= max_chars)\n            .last()\n            .unwrap_or(0);\n        &s[..boundary]\n    }\n}\n\n// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n// Tests\n// \"human\"))\n            .collect()\n    }\n\n    /// Get existing child beads (unravel-proposal children) for a parent bead.\n    fn count_existing_children(bead: &Bead) -> u32 {\n        bead.dependencies\n            .iter()\n            .filter(|d| d.dependency_type == \"blocks\")\n            .count() as u32\n    }\n\n    /// Build the unravel prompt for a human-blocked bead.\n    ///\n    /// Uses `config.prompt_template` when set; otherwise falls back to the\n    /// built-in template.  Template variables: `{id}`, `{title}`, `{body}`,\n    /// `{labels}`.\n    fn build_prompt(&self, bead: &Bead) -> String {\n        let body = bead.body.as_deref().unwrap_or(\"(no description)\");\n        let labels = bead.labels.join(\", \");\n\n        if let Some(template) = &self.config.prompt_template {\n            return template\n                .replace(\"{id}\", bead.id.as_ref())\n                .replace(\"{title}\", &bead.title)\n                .replace(\"{body}\", body)\n                .replace(\"{labels}\", &labels);\n        }\n\n        format!(\n            \"## Human-Blocked Bead\\n\\n\\\n             **ID:** {id}\\n\\\n             **Title:** {title}\\n\\\n             **Description:**\\n\\\n             {body}\\n\\\n             **Labels:** {labels}\\n\\n\\\n             ## Task\\n\\n\\\n             This bead is blocked because it requires a human decision. \\\n             Propose automated alternatives that could accomplish the same \\\n             goal without human intervention.\\n\\n\\\n             For each alternative, provide:\\n\\\n             - **title**: concise description of the alternative approach\\n\\\n             - **body**: what needs to be done (actionable, an agent can execute it)\\n\\n\\\n             Constraints:\\n\\\n             - Alternatives must be fully automatable (no human decisions needed)\\n\\\n             - Each alternative should be a self-contained, actionable task\\n\\\n             - Propose only viable alternatives, not partial workarounds\\n\\n\\\n             Output a JSON array of objects with \\\"title\\\" and \\\"body\\\" fields.\\n\\\n             If no viable automated alternative exists, respond with: NO_ALTERNATIVES\",\n            id = bead.id,\n            title = bead.title,\n            body = body,\n            labels = labels,\n        )\n    }\n\n    /// Parse the agent response into proposed alternatives.\n    pub fn parse_agent_response(response: &str) -> Result<Vec<ProposedAlternative>> {\n        let trimmed = response.trim();\n\n        // Check for NO_ALTERNATIVES sentinel.\n        if trimmed.contains(\"NO_ALTERNATIVES\") {\n            return Ok(vec![]);\n        }\n\n        // Try parsing as a JSON array directly.\n        if let Ok(alts) = serde_json::from_str::<Vec<ProposedAlternative>>(trimmed) {\n            return Ok(alts);\n        }\n\n        // Try extracting JSON from markdown code fences.\n        let json_str = extract_json_block(trimmed).unwrap_or(trimmed);\n\n        // Try as array.\n        if let Ok(alts) = serde_json::from_str::<Vec<ProposedAlternative>>(json_str) {\n            return Ok(alts);\n        }\n\n        // Try as object with \"alternatives\" field.\n        if let Ok(obj) = serde_json::from_str::<serde_json::Value>(json_str) {\n            if let Some(arr) = obj.get(\"alternatives\").and_then(|v| v.as_array()) {\n                let alts: Vec<ProposedAlternative> = arr\n                    .iter()\n                    .filter_map(|v| serde_json::from_value(v.clone()).ok())\n                    .collect();\n                if !alts.is_empty() {\n                    return Ok(alts);\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        anyhow::bail!(\"failed to parse agent response as proposed alternatives\")\n    }\n}\n\n#[async_trait::async_trait]\nimpl super::Strand for UnravelStrand {\n    fn name(&self) -> &str {\n        \"unravel\"\n    }\n\n    async fn evaluate(&self, store: &dyn BeadStore, _exclusions: &HashSet<BeadId>) -> StrandResult {\n        // Guard: disabled.\n        if !self.config.enabled {\n            tracing::debug!(\"unravel strand disabled\");\n            return StrandResult::NoWork;\n        }\n\n        // Check if the home bead store exists. If not, skip this strand.\n        // This distinguishes between \"no home store configured\" (expected for\n        // roam-only workers) and \"home store is broken\" (unexpected error).\n        if !store.has_valid_store() {\n            tracing::info!(\n                \"Home workspace has no .beads/ directory — skipping Unravel strand \\\n                 (expected for roam-only workers)\"\n            );\n            return StrandResult::Skipped {\n                reason: \"no_home_store\".to_string(),\n            };\n        }\n\n        // Load persistent state.\n        let state_path = self.state_file_path();\n        let mut state = match UnravelState::load(&state_path) {\n            Ok(s) => s,\n            Err(e) => {\n                tracing::warn!(error = %e, \"failed to load unravel state, using defaults\");\n                UnravelState::default()\n            }\n        };\n\n        // Query all beads and filter for human-labeled ones.\n        let all_beads = match store.list_all().await {\n            Ok(beads) => beads,\n            Err(e) => {\n                tracing::warn!(error = %e, \"unravel strand: failed to list beads\");\n                return StrandResult::Error(crate::types::StrandError::StoreError(e));\n            }\n        };\n\n        let human_beads = Self::filter_human_beads(&all_beads);\n        if human_beads.is_empty() {\n            tracing::debug!(\"unravel strand: no human-labeled beads found\");\n            return StrandResult::NoWork;\n        }\n\n        tracing::info!(\n            human_beads = human_beads.len(),\n            \"unravel strand: found human-labeled beads\"\n        );\n\n        // Process beads with guardrails.\n        let mut total_created = 0u32;\n        let mut beads_processed = 0u32;\n        let cooldown_hours = self.config.cooldown_hours as i64;\n\n        for bead in &human_beads {\n            // Guard: max beads per run.\n            if beads_processed >= self.config.max_beads_per_run {\n                tracing::info!(\n                    max = self.config.max_beads_per_run,\n                    \"unravel strand: max beads per run reached\"\n                );\n                break;\n            }\n\n            // Guard: cooldown — skip recently analyzed beads.\n            if state.is_in_cooldown(&bead.id, cooldown_hours) {\n                tracing::debug!(\n                    bead_id = %bead.id,\n                    \"unravel strand: bead is in cooldown, skipping\"\n                );\n                self.telemetry\n                    .emit(EventKind::UnravelSkipped {\n                        bead_id: bead.id.clone(),\n                        reason: \"cooldown\".to_string(),\n                    })\n                    .ok();\n                continue;\n            }\n\n            // Guard: max alternatives per bead — check existing children.\n            let existing_children = Self::count_existing_children(bead);\n            if existing_children >= self.config.max_alternatives_per_bead {\n                tracing::debug!(\n                    bead_id = %bead.id,\n                    existing_children,\n                    max = self.config.max_alternatives_per_bead,\n                    \"unravel strand: bead already has max alternatives, skipping\"\n                );\n                state.mark_analyzed(&bead.id);\n                continue;\n            }\n\n            let remaining_slots = self.config.max_alternatives_per_bead - existing_children;\n            beads_processed += 1;\n\n            // Build prompt and dispatch agent.\n            let prompt = self.build_prompt(bead);\n            let response = match self\n                .agent\n                .propose_alternatives(&prompt, &self.workspace)\n                .await\n            {\n                Ok(r) => r,\n                Err(e) => {\n                    tracing::warn!(\n                        bead_id = %bead.id,\n                        error = %e,\n                        \"unravel strand: agent dispatch failed\"\n                    );\n                    state.mark_analyzed(&bead.id);\n                    continue;\n                }\n            };\n\n            // Parse proposed alternatives.\n            let proposed = match Self::parse_agent_response(&response) {\n                Ok(p) => p,\n                Err(e) => {\n                    tracing::warn!(\n                        bead_id = %bead.id,\n                        error = %e,\n                        \"unravel strand: failed to parse agent response\"\n                    );\n                    state.mark_analyzed(&bead.id);\n                    continue;\n                }\n            };\n\n            if proposed.is_empty() {\n                tracing::info!(\n                    bead_id = %bead.id,\n                    \"unravel strand: no alternatives proposed\"\n                );\n                state.mark_analyzed(&bead.id);\n                continue;\n            }\n\n            // Build child specs, honoring the per-bead and per-run slot guards.\n            // Titles/bodies are owned here so the borrowed `NewChild` views below\n            // stay valid for the atomic split call.\n            let mut child_specs: Vec<(String, String)> = Vec::new();\n            for alternative in &proposed {\n                // Guard: remaining slots for this bead.\n                if child_specs.len() as u32 >= remaining_slots {\n                    break;\n                }\n\n                // Guard: max total created per run.\n                if total_created + child_specs.len() as u32 >= self.config.max_beads_per_run {\n                    break;\n                }\n\n                let child_title = format!(\"[Unravel] {} — {}\", bead.title, alternative.title);\n                let child_body = format!(\n                    \"## Alternative for: {}\\n\\\n                     Original bead: {id}\\n\\n\\\n                     {alt_body}\\n\\n\\\n                     ---\\n\\\n                     This is an automated alternative proposal created by the \\\n                     unravel strand. It is a child of the original human-blocked \\\n                     bead and can be executed independently.\",\n                    bead.title,\n                    id = bead.id,\n                    alt_body = alternative.body,\n                );\n                child_specs.push((child_title, child_body));\n            }\n\n            // Create all alternatives and link each as a blocker of the original\n            // bead in a single atomic operation. A crash mid-split rolls the\n            // whole thing back rather than orphaning a child with no dependency\n            // link (plan.md Phase 5.3, Race 3). This strand is best-effort: on\n            // failure we log and move on rather than aborting the run.\n            let mut created_for_this_bead = 0u32;\n            if !child_specs.is_empty() {\n                let labels: Vec<&str> = vec![\"unravel-proposal\"];\n                let new_children: Vec<NewChild> = child_specs\n                    .iter()\n                    .map(|(title, body)| NewChild {\n                        title,\n                        body,\n                        labels: &labels,\n                    })\n                    .collect();\n\n                match store.split_bead(&bead.id, &new_children).await {\n                    Ok(child_ids) => {\n                        for (child_id, (child_title, _)) in child_ids.iter().zip(child_specs.iter())\n                        {\n                            tracing::info!(\n                                parent_id = %bead.id,\n                                child_id = %child_id,\n                                child_title = %child_title,\n                                \"unravel strand: created alternative child bead\"\n                            );\n                        }\n                        created_for_this_bead = child_ids.len() as u32;\n                        total_created += created_for_this_bead;\n                    }\n                    Err(e) => {\n                        tracing::warn!(\n                            bead_id = %bead.id,\n                            error = %e,\n                            \"unravel strand: failed to create alternative children\"\n                        );\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n\n            // Emit telemetry for this bead.\n            self.telemetry\n                .emit(EventKind::UnravelAnalyzed {\n                    bead_id: bead.id.clone(),\n                    alternatives_proposed: created_for_this_bead,\n                })\n                .ok();\n\n            state.mark_analyzed(&bead.id);\n        }\n\n        // Save state.\n        if let Err(e) = state.save(&state_path) {\n            tracing::warn!(error = %e, \"unravel strand: failed to save state\");\n        }\n\n        if total_created > 0 {\n            tracing::info!(\n                created = total_created,\n                \"unravel strand: created alternative beads for human-blocked beads\"\n            );\n            StrandResult::WorkCreated\n        } else {\n            tracing::info!(\"unravel strand: no new alternatives created\");\n            StrandResult::NoWork\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// ─── Production agent ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n/// Production `UnravelAgent` that invokes the configured AI agent via subprocess.\n///\n/// The agent binary is called with `--print` so it emits the response as plain\n/// text on stdout without tool-use side-effects.  The prompt is written to a\n/// temp file and fed via stdin redirection.\npub struct CliUnravelAgent {\n    /// Agent binary name or path (e.g., `\"claude\"`).\n    agent_cmd: String,\n}\n\nimpl CliUnravelAgent {\n    /// Create a new `CliUnravelAgent`.\n    ///\n    /// `agent_cmd` is the binary used for analysis (typically taken from\n    /// `config.agent.default`).\n    pub fn new(agent_cmd: String) -> Self {\n        CliUnravelAgent { agent_cmd }\n    }\n}\n\n#[async_trait::async_trait]\nimpl UnravelAgent for CliUnravelAgent {\n    async fn propose_alternatives(&self, prompt: &str, workspace: &Path) -> Result<String> {\n        // Write the prompt to a temp file.\n        let tmp_dir = std::env::temp_dir().join(\"needle\");\n        std::fs::create_dir_all(&tmp_dir)\n            .context(\"failed to create needle temp dir for unravel\")?;\n        let tmp_file = tmp_dir.join(format!(\"unravel-{}.md\", std::process::id()));\n        std::fs::write(&tmp_file, prompt).context(\"failed to write unravel prompt to temp file\")?;\n\n        // Build the shell command: cd into workspace, pipe prompt to agent.\n        let cmd = format!(\n            \"cd {} && {} --print < {}\",\n            workspace.display(),\n            self.agent_cmd,\n            tmp_file.display(),\n        );\n\n        let output = tokio::process::Command::new(\"bash\")\n            .arg(\"-c\")\n            .arg(&cmd)\n            .output()\n            .await\n            .with_context(|| format!(\"failed to spawn unravel agent: {}\", self.agent_cmd))?;\n\n        // Always clean up the temp file.\n        let _ = std::fs::remove_file(&tmp_file);\n\n        if !output.status.success() {\n            anyhow::bail!(\n                \"unravel agent exited with code {}\",\n                output.status.code().unwrap_or(-1)\n            );\n        }\n\n        Ok(String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stdout).into_owned())\n    }\n}\n\n// ─── Helpers ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n/// Extract a JSON block from markdown-fenced content.\nfn extract_json_block(text: &str) -> Option<&str> {\n    let start_markers = [\"```json\\n\", \"```json\\r\\n\", \"```\\n\", \"```\\r\\n\"];\n    for marker in &start_markers {\n        if let Some(start) = text.find(marker) {\n            let content_start = start + marker.len();\n            if let Some(end) = text[content_start..].find(\"```\") {\n                return Some(&text[content_start..content_start + end]);\n            }\n        }\n    }\n    None\n}\n\n/// Compute a short SHA-256 hash of a workspace path (for state filenames).\nfn workspace_hash(workspace: &Path) -> String {\n    let mut hasher = Sha256::new();\n    hasher.update(workspace.display().to_string().as_bytes());\n    let result = hasher.finalize();\n    result\n        .iter()\n        .take(8)\n        .fold(String::with_capacity(16), |mut acc, b| {\n            use std::fmt::Write;\n            let _ = write!(acc, \"{b:02x}\");\n            acc\n        })\n}\n\n// ─── Unit tests Recursive discovery is now the documented intended default.\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]\npub struct ExploreConfig {\n    /// Whether the Explore strand is enabled.\n    #[serde(default = \"ExploreConfig::default_enabled\")]\n    pub enabled: bool,\n\n    /// **Pin/exception list** for restricting a worker to specific workspaces.\n    ///\n    /// When **empty** (the default), enables recursive discovery under `workspace_root`:\n    /// all directories containing a `.beads/` subdirectory are automatically scanned.\n    /// This is the intended default for the fleet — new workspaces are picked up\n    /// without configuration changes.\n    ///\n    /// When **non-empty**, disables auto-discovery and scans only these paths.\n    /// Use this to restrict a specific worker to a fixed repo set (e.g., a dedicated\n    /// worker for a high-priority workspace). Defaults to the user's home directory.\n    #[serde(default = \"ExploreConfig::default_workspace_root\")]\n    pub workspace_root: PathBuf,\n\n    /// Re-run workspace discovery every N cycles (0 = disabled).\n    ///\n    /// When set (default: 60), the workspace list is refreshed periodically\n    /// so new stores are picked up without requiring worker restarts.\n    /// Re-discovery preserves the \"no upward traversal\" constraint (only scanning\n    /// workspace_root's immediate children) and the \"explicit workspaces override\"\n    /// (when workspaces is non-empty, re-discovery is skipped).\n    ///\n    /// A modest default (60 cycles ≈ 1 hour at typical worker cadence) balances\n    /// freshness with filesystem churn. Set to 0 to disable periodic re-discovery.\n    #[serde(default = \"ExploreConfig::default_rediscovery_cycles\")]\n    pub rediscovery_cycles: u32,\n\n    /// Starvation alarm threshold in minutes (0 = disabled).\n    ///\n    /// When set (default: 15), emits a WARN telemetry event when ready beads\n    /// exist in scanned workspaces but this worker has not successfully claimed\n    /// any bead for the specified number of minutes. \"ExploreConfig::default_starvation_threshold_minutes\")]\n    pub starvation_threshold_minutes: u64,\n}\n\nimpl Default for ExploreConfig {\n    fn default() -> Self {\n        ExploreConfig {\n ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n/// Where a configuration value originated.\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]\npub enum ConfigSource {\n    /// Built-in default value.\n    Default,\n    /// Global config file (`~/.config/needle/config.yaml`).\n    GlobalFile(PathBuf),\n    /// Workspace config file (`.needle.yaml`).\n    WorkspaceFile(PathBuf),\n    /// Environment variable override.\n    EnvVar(String),\n    /// CLI argument override.\n    CliOverride,\n}\n\nimpl std::fmt::Display for ConfigSource {\n    fn fmt(&self, f: &mut std::fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> std::fmt::Result {\n        match self {\n            ConfigSource::Default => write!(f, \"built-in default\"),\n            ConfigSource::GlobalFile(p) => write!(f, \"{}\", p.display()),\n            ConfigSource::WorkspaceFile(p) => write!(f, \"{}\", p.display()),\n            ConfigSource::EnvVar(name) => write!(f, \"{} env var\", name),\n            ConfigSource::CliOverride => write!(f, \"CLI argument\"),\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n/// Map of config field paths to their source.\n///\n/// Used by `needle config --dump --show-source` to annotate each value.\npub type SourceMap = BTreeMap<String, ConfigSource>;\n\n// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n// Workspace Overrides\n// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n// Top-level Config\n// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n/// Fully resolved NEEDLE configuration.\n///\n/// Loaded once at boot, immutable during a session.\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Default, Serialize, Deserialize)]\npub struct Config {\n    #[serde(default)]\n    pub agent: AgentConfig,\n    #[serde(default)]\n    pub worker: WorkerConfig,\n    #[serde(default)]\n    pub workspace: WorkspaceConfig,\n    #[serde(default)]\n    pub strands: StrandsConfig,\n    #[serde(default)]\n    pub telemetry: TelemetryConfig,\n    #[serde(default)]\n    pub prompt: PromptConfig,\n    #[serde(default)]\n    pub health: HealthConfig,\n    /// Provider/model concurrency accepting closure.\n    /// Legacy format — prefer `gates` for new configurations.\n    #[serde(default)]\n    pub verification: Vec<String>,\n    /// Pluggable validation gates.\n    #[serde(default)]\n    pub gates: Vec<GateConfig>,\n    /// Self-modification (hot-reload) configuration.\n    #[serde(default)]\n    pub self_modification: SelfModificationConfig,\n    /// FABRIC Outcome handling configuration (failure circuit-breaker).\n    #[serde(default)]\n    pub outcome: OutcomeConfig,\n}\n\nimpl Config {\n    /// Expand all tilde (~) paths to absolute paths using $HOME.\n    ///\n    /// This must be called after deserialization to ensure all paths\n    /// like `~/.needle` are expanded to `/home/user/.needle`.\n    /// Paths without tildes are left unchanged.\n    pub fn expand_tildes(&mut self) {\n        // workspace section\n        self.workspace.default = expand_tilde(&self.workspace.default);\n        self.workspace.home = expand_tilde(&self.workspace.home);\n\n        // agent section\n        self.agent.adapters_dir = expand_tilde(&self.agent.adapters_dir);\n\n        // strands.explore section\n        self.strands.explore.workspace_root = expand_tilde(&self.strands.explore.workspace_root);\n        self.strands.explore.workspaces = expand_tilde_vec(&self.strands.explore.workspaces);\n\n        // strands.weave section\n        self.strands.weave.exclude_workspaces =\n            expand_tilde_vec(&self.strands.weave.exclude_workspaces);\n\n        // strands.splice section\n        self.strands.splice.report_workspace =\n            expand_tilde_option(&self.strands.splice.report_workspace);\n\n        // strands.pulse.scanners[].command paths are strings, not PathBuf, so skip\n\n        // strands.reflect section - no PathBuf fields\n\n        // strands.learning section\n        self.strands.learning.global_learnings_file =\n            expand_tilde(&self.strands.learning.global_learnings_file);\n\n        // telemetry section\n        if let Some(ref mut log_dir) = self.telemetry.file_sink.log_dir {\n            *log_dir = expand_tilde(log_dir);\n        }\n\n        // health section\n        self.health.heartbeat_dir = expand_tilde_option(&self.health.heartbeat_dir);\n\n        // supervisor section\n        self.supervisor.heartbeat_path = expand_tilde_option(&self.supervisor.heartbeat_path);\n        self.supervisor.socket_path = expand_tilde_option(&self.supervisor.socket_path);\n\n        // prompt section\n        self.prompt.context_files = expand_tilde_vec(&self.prompt.context_files);\n\n        // self_modification section\n        self.self_modification.canary_workspace =\n            expand_tilde(&self.self_modification.canary_workspace);\n\n        // prompt.variants[].content_file\n        for variants in self.prompt.variants.values_mut() {\n            for variant in variants {\n                variant.content_file = expand_tilde(&variant.content_file);\n            }\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n// Config validation\n// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n/// A single config validation error.\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]\npub struct ConfigError {\n    /// Dot-separated field path (e.g., `agent.default`).\n    pub field: String,\n    /// Human-readable explanation.\n    pub message: String,\n}\n\nimpl std::fmt::Display for ConfigError {\n    fn fmt(&self, f: &mut std::fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> std::fmt::Result {\n        write!(f, \"{}: {}\", self.field, self.message)\n    }\n}\n\n// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n// CLI overrides\n// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n/// Loads and validates NEEDLE configuration.\npub struct ConfigLoader;\n\nimpl ConfigLoader {\n    /// Load global config.\n    pub fn load_from_path(path: &Path) -> Result<Config> {\n        if !path.exists() {\n            let mut config = Config::default();\n            config.expand_tildes();\n            return Ok(config);\n        }\n        let text = std::fs::read_to_string(path)\n            .with_context(|| format!(\"failed to read config file: {}\", path.display()))?;\n        let mut config: Config = serde_yaml::from_str(&text)\n            .with_context(|| format!(\"invalid YAML in config file: {}\", path.display()))?;\n        config.expand_tildes();\n        Ok(config)\n    }\n\n    /// Load workspace overrides from `.needle.yaml` in the given workspace root.\n    ///\n    /// Returns `None` if the file does not exist. Emits warnings for\n    /// non-overridable keys found in the workspace config.\n    pub fn load_workspace(workspace_root: &Path) -> Result<Option<WorkspaceOverrides>> {\n        let path = workspace_root.join(\".needle.yaml\");\n        if !path.exists() {\n            return Ok(None);\n        }\n        let text = std::fs::read_to_string(&path)\n            .with_context(|| format!(\"failed to read workspace config: {}\", path.display()))?;\n\n        // Check for non-overridable keys and warn.\n        Self::warn_non_overridable_keys(&text, &path)?;\n\n        let overrides: WorkspaceOverrides = serde_yaml::from_str(&text)\n            .with_context(|| format!(\"invalid YAML in workspace config: {}\", path.display()))?;\n        Ok(Some(overrides))\n    }\n\n    /// Warn about non-overridable top-level keys in workspace config YAML.\n    fn warn_non_overridable_keys(yaml_text: &str, path: &Path) -> Result<()> {\n        let value: serde_yaml::Value = serde_yaml::from_str(yaml_text)\n            .with_context(|| format!(\"invalid YAML in workspace config: {}\", path.display()))?;\n\n        if let serde_yaml::Value::Mapping(map) = value {\n            for key in map.keys() {\n                if let serde_yaml::Value::String(key_str) = key {\n                    if NON_OVERRIDABLE_KEYS.contains(&key_str.as_str()) {\n                        tracing::warn!(\n                            key = %key_str,\n                            path = %path.display(),\n                            \"workspace config contains non-overridable setting '{}' — ignored\",\n                            key_str,\n                        );\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n        }\n        Ok(())\n    }\n\n    /// Apply workspace overrides to a config.\n    ///\n    /// Only overridable fields are applied. Records sources in the source map.\n    pub fn apply_workspace(\n        config: &mut Config,\n        overrides: &WorkspaceOverrides,\n        ws_path: &Path,\n        sources: &mut SourceMap,\n    ) {\n        let source = ConfigSource::WorkspaceFile(ws_path.join(\".needle.yaml\"));\n\n        if let Some(ref agent) = overrides.agent {\n            if let Some(ref default) = agent.default {\n                config.agent.default = default.clone();\n                sources.insert(\"agent.default\".to_string(), source.clone());\n            }\n            if let Some(timeout) = agent.timeout {\n                config.agent.timeout = timeout;\n                sources.insert(\"agent.timeout\".to_string(), source.clone());\n            }\n            if let Some(ref routing) = agent.routing {\n                config.agent.routing = Some(routing.clone());\n                sources.insert(\"agent.routing\".to_string(), source.clone());\n            }\n        }\n\n        if let Some(ref strands) = overrides.strands {\n            if let Some(ref weave_val) = strands.weave {\n                if let Ok(weave_cfg) = serde_yaml::from_value::<WeaveConfig>(weave_val.clone()) {\n                    config.strands.weave = weave_cfg;\n                }\n                sources.insert(\"strands.weave\".to_string(), source.clone());\n            }\n            if let Some(ref pulse_val) = strands.pulse {\n                if let Ok(pulse_cfg) = serde_yaml::from_value::<PulseConfig>(pulse_val.clone()) {\n                    config.strands.pulse = pulse_cfg;\n                }\n                sources.insert(\"strands.pulse\".to_string(), source.clone());\n            }\n            if let Some(ref unravel_val) = strands.unravel {\n                if let Ok(unravel_cfg) =\n                    serde_yaml::from_value::<UnravelConfig>(unravel_val.clone())\n                {\n                    config.strands.unravel = unravel_cfg;\n                }\n                sources.insert(\"strands.unravel\".to_string(), source.clone());\n            }\n        }\n\n        if let Some(ref prompt) = overrides.prompt {\n            config.prompt = prompt.clone();\n            sources.insert(\"prompt.context_files\".to_string(), source.clone());\n            sources.insert(\"prompt.instructions\".to_string(), source.clone());\n        }\n\n        if let Some(ref verification) = overrides.verification {\n            config.verification = verification.clone();\n            sources.insert(\"verification\".to_string(), source.clone());\n        }\n\n        if let Some(ref gates) = overrides.gates {\n            config.gates = gates.clone();\n            sources.insert(\"gates\".to_string(), source.clone());\n        }\n\n        if let Some(ref ws) = overrides.workspace {\n            if !ws.labels.is_empty() {\n                config.workspace.labels = ws.labels.clone();\n                sources.insert(\"workspace.labels\".to_string(), source);\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// Apply environment variable overrides (`NEEDLE_*` prefix, `__` separator).\n    ///\n    /// Example: `NEEDLE_AGENT__DEFAULT=opus` sets `agent.default` to `\"opus\"`.\n    pub fn apply_env_overrides(config: &mut Config, sources: &mut SourceMap) {\n        for (key, value) in std::env::vars() {\n            if let Some(suffix) = key.strip_prefix(\"NEEDLE_\") {\n                let config_path = suffix.to_lowercase().replace(\"__\", \".\");\n                let source = ConfigSource::EnvVar(key.clone());\n\n                match config_path.as_str() {\n                    \"agent.default\" => {\n                        config.agent.default = value;\n                        sources.insert(config_path, source);\n                    }\n                    \"agent.timeout\" => {\n                        if let Ok(v) = value.parse::<u64>() {\n                            config.agent.timeout = v;\n value = %value,\n                                \"invalid value for agent.timeout — expected integer\"\n                            );\n                        }\n                    }\n .get_or_insert_with(RoutingConfig::default)\n                            .default_adapter = Some(value);\n                        sources.insert(config_path, source);\n                    }\n                    \"worker.max_workers\" => {\n                        if let Ok(v) = value.parse::<u32>() {\n                            config.worker.max_workers = v;\n                            sources.insert(config_path, source);\n                        } else {\n                            tracing::warn!(\n                                env_var = %key,\n                                value = %value,\n                                \"invalid value for worker.max_workers — expected integer\"\n                            );\n                        }\n                    }\n                    \"worker.idle_timeout\" => {\n                        if let Ok(v) = value.parse::<u64>() {\n                            config.worker.idle_timeout = v;\n                            sources.insert(config_path, source);\n                        } else {\n                            tracing::warn!(\n                                env_var = %key,\n                                value = %value,\n                                \"invalid value for worker.idle_timeout — expected integer\"\n                            );\n                        }\n                    }\n                    \"worker.launch_stagger_seconds\" => {\n                        if let Ok(v) = value.parse::<u64>() {\n                            config.worker.launch_stagger_seconds = v;\n                            sources.insert(config_path, source);\n                        } else {\n                            tracing::warn!(\n                                env_var = %key,\n                                value = %value,\n                                \"invalid value for worker.launch_stagger_seconds — expected integer\"\n                            );\n                        }\n config.health.heartbeat_interval_secs = v;\n                            sources.insert(config_path, source);\n                        } else {\n                            tracing::warn!(\n                                env_var = %key,\n                                value = %value,\n                                \"invalid value for health.heartbeat_interval_secs — expected integer\"\n                            );\n                        }\n                    }\n                    \"health.heartbeat_ttl_secs\" => {\n                        if let Ok(v) = value.parse::<u64>() {\n                            config.health.heartbeat_ttl_secs = v;\n                            sources.insert(config_path, source);\n                        } else {\n                            tracing::warn!(\n                                env_var = %key,\n                                value = %value,\n                                \"invalid value for health.heartbeat_ttl_secs —                    tracing::warn!(\n                                env_var = %key,\n                                value = %value,\n                                \"invalid value for                     sources.insert(config_path, source);\n                    }\n                    \"supervisor.socket_path\" => {\n                        config.supervisor.socket_path = config.workspace.home = expand_tilde(&PathBuf::from(value));\n                        sources.insert(config_path, source);\n                    }\n                    \"workspace.default\" => {\n                        config.workspace.default = expand_tilde(&PathBuf::from(value));\n                        sources.insert(config_path, source);\n                    }\n                    _ => {\n with source tracking.\n    pub fn apply_cli_overrides(\n        config: &mut Config,\n        overrides: CliOverrides,\n        sources: &mut SourceMap,\n    ) {\n        if let Some(ws) = overrides.workspace {\n            config.workspace.default = ws;\n            sources.insert(\"workspace.default\".to_string(), ConfigSource::CliOverride);\n        }\n        if let Some(agent) = overrides.agent_binary {\n            config.agent.default = agent;\n            sources.insert(\"agent.default\".to_string(), ConfigSource::CliOverride);\n        }\n        if let Some(n) = overrides.max_workers {\n            config.worker.max_workers = n;\n            sources.insert(\"worker.max_workers\".to_string(), ConfigSource::CliOverride);\n        }\n        if let Some(explore_root) = overrides.explore_workspace_root {\n            config.strands.explore.workspace_root = explore_root;\n            sources.insert(\n                \"explore.workspace_root\".to_string(),\n                ConfigSource::CliOverride,\n            );\n        }\n        // worker_name is handled at the Worker level, not stored in Config\n    }\n\n    /// Load the fully resolved configuration using the complete hierarchy:\n    ///\n    /// defaults → global file → workspace `.needle.yaml` → env vars → CLI args\n    ///\n    /// Returns the resolved config and a source map showing where each value\n    /// came from. The source map only contains entries for values that were\n    /// overridden from their defaults.\n    pub fn load_resolved(workspace_root: &Path, cli: CliOverrides) -> Result<(Config, SourceMap)> {\n        let mut sources = SourceMap::new();\n\n        // Layer 1 + 2: defaults + global config.\n        let global_path = dirs_or_home(\".config/needle/config.yaml\");\n        let mut config = Self::load_from_path(&global_path)?;\n\n        // Track which fields came from global config (if file existed).\n        if global_path.exists() {\n            let source = ConfigSource::GlobalFile(global_path);\n            // Mark all top-level sections as from global.\n            for key in &[\n                \"agent.default\",\n                \"agent.timeout\",\n                \"worker.max_workers\",\n                \"worker.idle_timeout\",\n                \"health.heartbeat_interval_secs\",\n                \"health.heartbeat_ttl_secs\",\n            ] {\n                sources.insert((*key).to_string(), source.clone());\n            }\n        }\n\n        // Layer 3: workspace config.\n        if let Some(ws_overrides) = Self::load_workspace(workspace_root)? {\n            Self::apply_workspace(&mut config, &ws_overrides, workspace_root, &mut sources);\n        }\n\n        // Layer 4: environment variables.\n        Self::apply_env_overrides(&mut config, &mut sources);\n\n        // Layer 5: CLI arguments.\n        Self::apply_cli_overrides(&mut config, cli, &mut sources);\n\n        // Expand all tildes after all overrides are applied.\n        config.expand_tildes();\n\n        Ok((config, sources))\n    }\n\n    /// Emit boot-time warnings for configuration issues that should be addressed.\n    ///\n    /// These are non-fatal issues that don't prevent NEEDLE from running but\n    /// should be visible at startup to avoid silent misconfiguration.\n    fn emit_warnings(config: &Config) {\n        // Warn if Splice is enabled but report_workspace is not configured.\n        // This is critical because without a report_workspace, Splice will silently\n        // no-op on every cycle instead of creating failure/loop beads.\n        if config.strands.splice.enabled && config.strands.splice.report_workspace.is_none() {\n            tracing::warn!(\n                \"strands.splice.enabled is true, but strands.splice.report_workspace is not set. \\\n                 Splice will not create worker failure or loop detection beads. \\\n                 Set strands.splice.report_workspace to a valid workspace path in your config \\\n                 (e.g., ~/.config/needle/config.yaml or .needle.yaml).\"\n            );\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// Validate a resolved config.\n    ///\n    /// Returns a list of errors (empty = valid).\n    pub fn validate(config: &Config) -> Vec<ConfigError> {\n        let mut errors = Vec::new();\n\n        if config.agent.default.is_empty() {\n            errors.push(ConfigError {\n                field: \"agent.default\".to_string(),\n                message: \"must not be empty\".to_string(),\n            });\n        }\n\n        if config.worker.max_workers == 0 {\n            errors.push(ConfigError {\n                field: \"worker.max_workers\".to_string(),\n                message: \"must be at least 1\".to_string(),\n            });\n        }\n\n        if config.worker.max_workers > 50 {\n            errors.push(ConfigError {\n                field: \"worker.max_workers\".to_string(),\n                message: format!(\n                    \"{} exceeds practical fleet limit of 50\",\n                    config.worker.max_workers\n                ),\n            });\n        }\n\n        if config.worker.cpu_load_warn <= 0.0 || config.worker.cpu_load_warn > 1.0 {\n            errors.push(ConfigError {\n                field: \"worker.cpu_load_warn\".to_string(),\n                message: \"must be in range (0.0, 1.0]\".to_string(),\n            });\n        }\n\n        if config.health.heartbeat_ttl_secs < 3 * config.health.heartbeat_interval_secs {\n            errors.push(ConfigError {\n                field: \"health.heartbeat_ttl_secs\".to_string(),\n                message: format!(\n                    \"should be >= 3 * heartbeat_interval_secs ({}); detection may be unreliable\",\n                    3 * config.health.heartbeat_interval_secs\n                ),\n            });\n        }\n\n        // Emit boot-time warnings for configuration issues that should be addressed\n        // but are not fatal errors.\n        Self::emit_warnings(config);\n\n        // Validate routing regex patterns.\n        if let Some(ref routing) = config.agent.routing {\n            for (idx, rule) in routing.rules.iter().enumerate() {\n                // Validate that match_model is a valid regex.\n                if let Err(e) = regex::Regex::new(&rule.match_model) {\n                    errors.push(ConfigError {\n                        field: format!(\"agent.routing.rules[{}].match_model\", idx),\n                        message: format!(\"invalid regex pattern '{}': {}\", rule.match_model, e),\n                    });\n                }\n                // Validate that adapter is not empty.\n                if rule.adapter.is_empty() {\n                    errors.push(ConfigError {\n                        field: format!(\"agent.routing.rules[{}].adapter\", idx),\n                        message: \"must not be empty\".to_string(),\n                    });\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        errors\n    }\n\n    /// Format config values with source annotations for `--dump --show-source`.\n    pub fn dump_with_sources(config: &Config, sources: &SourceMap) -> Vec<String> {\n        let fields: Vec<(&str, String)> = vec![\n            (\"agent.default\", config.agent.default.clone()),\n            (\"agent.timeout\", config.agent.timeout.to_string()),\n            (\"worker.max_workers\", config.worker.max_workers.to_string()),\n            (\n                \"worker.idle_timeout\",\n                config.worker.idle_timeout.to_string(),\n            ),\n            (\n                \"worker.launch_stagger_seconds\",\n                config.worker.launch_stagger_seconds.to_string(),\n            ),\n            (\n                \"health.heartbeat_interval_secs\",\n                config.health.heartbeat_interval_secs.to_string(),\n            ),\n            (\n                \"health.heartbeat_ttl_secs\",\n                config.health.heartbeat_ttl_secs.to_string(),\n            ),\n            (\n                \"prompt.context_files\",\n                format!(\"{:?}\", config.prompt.context_files),\n            ),\n            (\n                \"prompt.instructions\",\n                config\n                    .prompt\n                    .instructions\n                    .as_deref()\n                    .unwrap_or(\"\")\n                    .to_string(),\n            ),\n        ];\n\n        fields\n            .into_iter()\n            .map(|(key, value)| {\n                let source = sources.get(key).cloned().unwrap_or(ConfigSource::Default);\n                format!(\"{}: {} (from: {})\", key, value, source)\n            })\n            .collect()\n    }\n}\n\n// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n// Helpers\n// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n/// Resolve a path relative to the user's home directory.\nfn dirs_or_home(relative: &str) -> PathBuf {\n    if let Some(home) = std::env::var_os(\"HOME\") {\n        PathBuf::from(home).join(relative)\n    } else {\n        PathBuf::from(\"/tmp\").join(relative)\n    }\n}\n\n/// Expand a leading tilde (~) to the user's home directory.\n///\n/// - `~/path` → `$HOME/path`\n/// - `~` → `$HOME`\n/// - `/absolute/path` → unchanged\n/// - `relative/path` → unchanged\n///\n/// Returns the path unchanged if HOME is not set.\nfn expand_tilde(path: &Path) -> PathBuf {\n    let path_str = path.as_os_str().to_str().unwrap_or(\"\");\n\n    // Check if path starts with ~/ or is exactly ~\n    if path_str == \"~\" {\n        if let Some(home) = std::env::var_os(\"HOME\") {\n            return PathBuf::from(home);\n        }\n    } else if let Some(rest) = path_str.strip_prefix(\"~/\") {\n        if let Some(home) = std::env::var_os(\"HOME\") {\n            return PathBuf::from(home).join(rest);\n        }\n    }\n\n    // No tilde or HOME not set, return as-is\n    path.to_path_buf()\n}\n\n/// Expand tildes in a vector of PathBufs.\nfn expand_tilde_vec(paths: &[PathBuf]) -> Vec<PathBuf> {\n    paths.iter().map(|p| expand_tilde(p)).collect()\n}\n\n/// Expand tildes in an optional PathBuf.\nfn expand_tilde_option(path: &Option<PathBuf>) -> Option<PathBuf> {\n    path.as_ref().map(|p| expand_tilde(p))\n}\n\n// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n// Tests\n// empty.\n/// - All directories under `workspace_root` containing a `.beads/` subdirectory\n///   are automatically discovered and scanned for beads.\n/// - This is the intended default for the fleet as a whole — new workspaces are\n///   picked up automatically without configuration changes.\n///\n/// **Pinned mode (exception):** Set `workspaces` to an explicit list of paths.\n/// - Only the specified workspaces are scanned; auto-discovery is disabled.\n/// - Use this to restrict a specific worker to a fixed repo set (e.g., a dedicated\n///   worker for a high-priority workspace that should not process other work).\n/// - This is an exception mechanism — the fleet should normally run with `workspaces`\n///   empty to avoid missing beads in newly-added workspaces.\n///\n/// ## Rationale\n///\n/// The 2026-07-19 fleet incident occurred because `explore.workspaces` was populated\n/// with 24 hardcoded paths. This permanently disabled discovery fleet-wide, and the\n/// list had already drifted stale (missing valid repos like commitgraph and\n/// twitterapi-proxy). Recursive discovery is now the documented intended default.\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]\npub struct ExploreConfig {\n    /// Whether the Explore strand is enabled.\n    #[serde(default = \"ExploreConfig::default_enabled\")]\n    pub enabled: bool,\n\n    /// **Pin/exception list** for restricting a worker to specific workspaces.\n    ///\n    /// When **empty** (the default), enables recursive discovery under `workspace_root`:\n    /// all directories containing a `.beads/` subdirectory are automatically scanned.\n    /// This is the intended default for the fleet — new workspaces are picked up\n    /// without configuration changes.\n    ///\n    /// When **non-empty**, disables auto-discovery and scans only these paths.\n    /// Use this to restrict a specific worker to a fixed repo set (e.g., a dedicated\n    /// worker for a high-priority workspace). This is an exception mechanism — most\n    /// workers should leave this empty to avoid missing beads in newly-added workspaces.\n    ///\n    /// **WARNING:** When non-empty, a WARN log is emitted at startup naming the\n    /// pinned repos, so operators can immediately see when a worker is running in\n    /// restricted/exception mode rather than discovering this only via missing beads.\n    #[serde(default)]\n    pub workspaces: Vec<PathBuf>,\n\n    /// Root path for workspace auto-discovery (when `workspaces` is empty).\n    ///\n    /// All directories under this path containing a `.beads/` subdirectory\n    /// are treated as workspaces.
